title: Linear pricing - Free for small teams, $10-$18 per user/month paid tiers
clean_text: Linear's Free plan supports unlimited members but caps usage at 250 non-archived issues and 2 teams. The Basic plan is $10/user/month (annual billing), removing the issue cap, raising the team limit to 5, and adding unlimited file uploads, admin roles, and full API access. The Business plan is reported at $16-18/user/month and adds Linear Asks, Linear Insights, private teams, guest accounts, triage responsibility, unlimited teams, and Zendesk/Intercom integrations. Enterprise is custom-priced. For a 10-person team, Basic runs about $1,200/year and Business about $1,920/year.
